bead.title: Add hybrid chaos and conformance coverage
bead.description: Add aggressive correctness coverage for objectlog/hybrid. Cover SQLite commit before memory failure and poison behavior, recovery from SQLite high-water plus object-log tail, disk-loss full replay from retained object log, replay overlap/idempotent prefix skip, force-seal before claim, stale epoch/fenced writer, request-id replay after committed-but-unreturned pushes, secondary-index parity, and metrics parity. Run the shared eventual-apply conformance and transaction-contract scenarios against hybrid. Out of scope: long release-tier 10M performance runs; keep default tests CI-feasible.
bead.acceptance:
1. cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_chaos -- --nocapture passes.
2. cargo test -p pqueue-server --test server objectlog_hybrid -- --nocapture passes.
3. cargo test -p pqueue-conformance -- --nocapture passes.
4. cargo test --workspace --all-features passes.
5. cargo fmt --check passes.
